"absolute" has no effect: "sr-only" declares "position" with the same value. Remove "absolute".
"flex" overrides "line-clamp-1" on "display". "flex" comes later in the generated stylesheet, so it wins no matter how the class attribute is ordered. Remove one.
"p-6" overrides "p-4" on "padding". "p-6" comes later in the generated stylesheet, so it wins no matter how the class attribute is ordered. Remove one.
"text-sm" overrides "text-base" on "font-size", "line-height". "text-sm" comes later in the generated stylesheet, so it wins no matter how the class attribute is ordered. Remove one.
